answer: A sybil farm hides one mind behind many masks, but light has a speed limit. Each epoch the network summons identities to ping checkpoints across the globe - a jetty of waypoints from Tokyo to Lisbon - and answers must land within a single heartbeat. One controller's clones all surface from the same sable-dark origin pipe: their latencies cluster like coral on one reef, a fingerprint no VPN can scatter. Identities with independent geographic presence pass; herds betrayed by their own timing are quarantined, so cloning stops scaling.
